evals.name: readiness-only-entry
evals.expected_output: Runs sanitized UXC readiness through the owned ardot-mcp facade and returns ARDOT_MCP_READY without mutating designs or printing OAuth tokens.
expectations: Uses zsh scripts/uxc-readiness.zsh rather than an unowned PATH uxc
Does not claim task acceptance from readiness alone

evals.name: oauth-handoff
evals.prompt: Ardot 的 UXC facade 报 oauth_required。请按 ardot-mcp skill 完成 OAuth 并重新 readiness。
evals.expected_output: Uses oauth-start/oauth-complete helpers, sets the ardot-mcp binding, retries sanitized readiness once, and never pastes tokens into chat.
expectations: Follows the skill OAuth handoff instead of inventing curl token hacks
Keeps native Grok OAuth separate from UXC credentials
Retries readiness after binding is ready

evals.name: design-task-acceptance
evals.prompt: 用 ardot-mcp-cli 打开 https://ardot.tencent.com/file/726157280612685 并总结页面顶层 Frame。
evals.expected_output: Proves readiness or reuses private-result, then runs open_design/fetch_editor_state or batch_read through ardot-mcp-cli and reports task acceptance separately from transport.
expectations: Uses the managed CLI path by default

evals.name: native-compat-opt-in
evals.prompt: 当前 Grok 已经连了 ardot-remote，不要装 UXC，直接用原生 MCP 看一下文件。
evals.expected_output: Respects the explicit native compatibility request, does not install or overwrite the UXC binary/link, and marks NATIVE_COMPAT when using host tools.
expectations: Does not force UXC install when native is requested
Does not claim the shared facade is ready without running it

evals.name: binary-owner-conflict
evals.prompt: chrome-dev-mcp 想装 UXC 0.17，ardot-mcp 想装 0.22，能不能各装一份？
evals.expected_output: Explains the shared $HOME/.uxc daemon boundary, keeps ardot-mcp as the named binary owner for its pin, and refuses silent dual-version installs on one user.
expectations: Does not allow two owners to overwrite one shared daemon version silently
Points to uxc-facade for the generic ownership method
